Use the employer’s public board name, not an applicant profile or private hiring dashboard.

pb-connector-guides.recruit-greenhouse.a: Agents cannot apply, contact candidates or change the approved board filters themselves.

pb-connector-guides.seo-wordpress.step1: In the client WordPress profile, create a separate credential under Application Passwords for a user allowed to create drafts.
pb-connector-guides.seo-wordpress.step2: In the SEO desk, enter the HTTPS site address, username and application password for this session.
pb-connector-guides.seo-wordpress.step3: Review the current client-approved article, approve saving its exact draft, then publish it yourself in WordPress.
pb-connector-guides.seo-wordpress.skippe: Use a dedicated user with only the needed draft permissions. An application password inherits that user’s access; it is not a draft-only permission.

Create an API token with Workers KV Storage Write access for only the chosen account, then enter its token, namespace ID and site in the SEO desk.
Review the existing value and client-approved replacement, then approve the exact change. Undo asks separately.
pb-connector-guides.seo-cloudflare-kv.sk: The client must already have a Worker using this namespace. Chausar does not install one or create the namespace.
pb-connector-guides.seo-cloudflare-kv.ch: Saving settings checks their shape, not live access. Staging reads the existing key; applying checks the saved value. Changes can take time to appear elsewhere.
pb-connector-guides.seo-cloudflare-kv.se: Sends: only an exact approved existing-key replacement or separately approved undo.
pb-connector-guides.seo-cloudflare-kv.ag: Agents cannot provision Workers, change other keys or retry an unknown write. Inspect uncertain results manually.

pb-connector-guides.overpass.step1: In the lead desk, choose a city area and the kind of business you want to research.
pb-connector-guides.overpass.step2: Review the bounded area and run the one-off public map search. No key is needed.
pb-connector-guides.overpass.step3: Check the returned sources and keep OpenStreetMap attribution with any reused data.
pb-connector-guides.overpass.skipped: OpenStreetMap coverage can be incomplete. Keep attribution and the ODbL licence on derived databases.
pb-connector-guides.overpass.checks: There is no sign-in check. The requested bounded Overpass query either returns public map records or a clear refusal.
pb-connector-guides.overpass.sends: Sends: only the chosen public map query. It does not contact businesses or change OpenStreetMap.
pb-connector-guides.overpass.agentLimits: Agents cannot turn missing map details into verified emails or run unrestricted scraping.
pb-connector-guides.overpass.charges: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.
pb-connector-guides.nominatim.step1: Read https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/ before using the public city lookup.
pb-connector-guides.nominatim.step2: Enter a city name deliberately in the lead desk. Never send personal addresses or confidential text.
pb-connector-guides.nominatim.step3: Check the returned city area. If lookup is unavailable, choose the city box manually.
pb-connector-guides.nominatim.skipped: Use city lookups only. No autocomplete, repeated bulk geocoding, systematic area searches or resale of geocoding results.
pb-connector-guides.nominatim.checks: No key is checked. Deliberate lookups are cached and serialised with at most one request per second.
pb-connector-guides.nominatim.sends: Sends: the requested city name to the public Nominatim service, not a customer address.
pb-connector-guides.nominatim.agentLimit: Agents cannot use this as a general address service. Respect the linked policy and keep map attribution.
pb-connector-guides.nominatim.charges: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.
pb-connector-guides.own-site.step1: Choose the business’s own public website for a lead in the lead desk.
pb-connector-guides.own-site.step2: Request the limited contact-page read only where the site terms permit it.
pb-connector-guides.own-site.step3: Review each found contact and its source before keeping or using it.
pb-connector-guides.own-site.skipped: Chausar obeys robots and reads the homepage plus at most three same-host contact pages. A refusal is not bypassed.
pb-connector-guides.own-site.checks: There is no account check. Public page reads use the network and source-policy guards; missing details remain missing.
pb-connector-guides.own-site.sends: Sends: public page requests only. No forms, emails or messages are submitted.
pb-connector-guides.own-site.agentLimits: Agents cannot guess email addresses, enter private accounts or evade site restrictions.
pb-connector-guides.own-site.charges: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.
pb-connector-guides.happenstance.step1: Use your own Happenstance account and API key from its developer settings.
pb-connector-guides.happenstance.step2: In the lead desk, write the exact search and read the dated credit quote.
pb-connector-guides.happenstance.step3: Enter your key for this search and approve the displayed query and credit cost together.
pb-connector-guides.happenstance.skipped: The query can use your network. Check the exact text and current credit quote before approving; a key alone is not permission to spend.
pb-connector-guides.happenstance.checks: There is no separate key test. The exact approved search checks the provider response and records whether it was confirmed.
pb-connector-guides.happenstance.sends: Sends: only the exact owner-approved paid search. Open the returned Happenstance result yourself.
pb-connector-guides.happenstance.agentLi: Agents cannot send outreach or retry an unknown search. Check your Happenstance account after an uncertain result.
pb-connector-guides.happenstance.charges: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.
pb-connector-guides.article-transcript.s: Open the client article order and record your permission to use the episode.
Add the episode transcript as SRT, VTT or TXT, then choose it in the article desk.
Review the source and outline before drafting. Reuse a source only for the same client.
Check that the file contains the episode words you may reuse, not unrelated private material.
pb-connector-guides.article-transcript.c: Chausar reads the selected file and binds drafts to its current source. There is no remote transcript account to check.
pb-connector-guides.article-transcript.s: Sends: nothing for file import. Any later model request has its own preview and approval.
pb-connector-guides.article-transcript.a: Agents cannot borrow another client’s transcript or treat unsupported statements as source evidence.
pb-connector-guides.article-local-transc: Use the desktop app with ffmpeg and whisper.cpp already installed by you.
Record episode rights, select the local audio or video in the article desk and approve the source import.
Read the resulting transcript before drafting. If local tools are unavailable, add a transcript file instead.
Local media is limited to 50 MB. For larger episodes, supply a transcript; Chausar does not install tools for you.
The approved import copies the local source and checks the installed tools when transcription runs. Hosted web cannot run them.
Sends: no recording to a remote transcription service. Processing uses the installed tools on this computer.
Agents cannot install software or claim a transcript exists when local processing fails.
pb-connector-guides.article-publishing.s: Finish source review, the owner-approved outline and the article draft.
Complete the required client-use review and approve the exact final article and companion text.
Copy the approved handoff into the client publishing account and publish it yourself.
A changed article needs fresh approval. No publishing password belongs in this handoff.
pb-connector-guides.article-publishing.c: Chausar checks the saved source and exact approval before preparing the handoff. It does not check a publishing account or prove publication.
pb-connector-guides.article-publishing.s: Sends: nothing to a publisher. Copy and publish the approved article yourself.
pb-connector-guides.article-publishing.a: Agents cannot publish or mark a manual handoff as a confirmed live article.
pb-connector-guides.newsletter-owner-too: Prepare the issue from approved sources in the newsletter desk. No sending-service key is needed.
Before importing a recipient list or exporting, obtain the named lawyer’s consent confirmation. Draft preparation remains available meanwhile.
Approve the exact issue and recipients, export HTML, plain text and recipient CSV, then send through your existing tool yourself.
Consent review is not yet confirmed. Keep list use and export blocked until that review is genuinely recorded.
Chausar checks current consent, suppression and exact approval before export. It does not connect to or test your sending account.
Sends: nothing. You import the approved files and send with your own newsletter tool.
Agents cannot send email, bypass opt-outs or claim a successful delivery from an export.
pb-connector-guides.tender-documents.ste: Attach client evidence separately from the RFP in the tender order.
Choose pasted questions or an RFP file. For a workbook, map the sheet, question column, answer column and row range.
Review every extracted question and its type before drafting. Write commercial answers yourself.
pb-connector-guides.tender-documents.ski: The RFP is a request, not evidence that the client meets it. Do not use a copied RFP as client evidence.
pb-connector-guides.tender-documents.che: Chausar binds questions and answers to current source bytes. Changed sources require import and approval again.
pb-connector-guides.tender-documents.sen: Sends: nothing for local reading. A later AI request shows its exact source payload and asks separately.
pb-connector-guides.tender-documents.age: Agents cannot borrow documents from another client, invent certifications or write commercial answers.
pb-connector-guides.tender-submission.st: Resolve source gaps and approve every answer by type.
Review the exact export pack, including the issuer workbook mapping and source amount receipts, then approve export.
Check the current issuer instructions and submit through your own portal or mail account.
pb-connector-guides.tender-submission.sk: A downloaded pack does not prove submission or acceptance. Check the issuer deadline and current terms yourself.
pb-connector-guides.tender-submission.ch: Chausar rechecks source bytes, exact answers and approvals before export. It does not test a portal account.
pb-connector-guides.tender-submission.se: Sends: nothing to the issuer. You submit the approved files yourself.
pb-connector-guides.tender-submission.ag: Agents cannot log in to a tender portal, submit a bid or claim the issuer accepted it.
pb-connector-guides.website-cloudflare.s: Create an existing Direct Upload project in your own Cloudflare account and upload the immutable assets there.
In the website desk, enter the account, project and production branch, then enter a token scoped to that project for this session.
Paste the exact asset manifest and release marker. Approve the preview, check its observed marker, then approve production separately.
Git-triggered projects are refused. A manifest does not upload missing assets. Unknown outcomes require inspection in Cloudflare before any retry.
pb-connector-guides.website-cloudflare.c: Chausar verifies the project and source checks, reads the exact deployment identity and observes its release marker. Missing evidence is not a pass.
pb-connector-guides.website-cloudflare.s: Sends: only the exact separately approved preview, production or rollback request. Connecting reads project settings without deploying.
pb-connector-guides.website-cloudflare.a: Agents cannot deploy, promote a preview, upload assets, buy a domain or retry an uncertain write on their own.
pb-connector-guides.website-cloudflare.c: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.
Set the approved public HTTPS client address in the website order.
Open the website desk and choose Check public website. The request follows network and robots rules.
For runtime UI checks, install lintapple yourself or attach its actual report. Read missing evidence as unmeasured.
Never treat a source-code audit or missing checker as a measured browser result. Restricted or private websites are not bypassed.
Chausar records actual public-page results and the checker report when the installed checker is available.
Sends: public read requests only. No forms, messages, site edits or deployment requests are sent.
Agents cannot bypass robots, install tools automatically or invent a passing measurement.
Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.
pb-connector-guides.google-tts.step1: Use your own Google Cloud project with billing and Text-to-Speech enabled. Restrict its API key to that API.
pb-connector-guides.google-tts.step2: Open the narration desk, choose the client order and save the project key. Saving does not make a test call.
pb-connector-guides.google-tts.step3: Read the current text, licensed stock voice and exact computed cost. Approve that one request, then verify and listen to the actual audio.
pb-connector-guides.google-tts.skipped: Client production waits for a named lawyer to confirm narration rights. Private manuscripts and cloning do not use this cloud route.
pb-connector-guides.google-tts.checks: Saving a key does not contact Google or prove access. An approved call checks the actual response; an uncertain outcome is never retried automatically.
pb-connector-guides.google-tts.sends: Sends: only the exact approved text and stock voice to Google, paid on your own key.
pb-connector-guides.google-tts.agentLimi: Agents cannot approve paid speech, switch the approved account, clone a voice or claim distributor acceptance.
pb-connector-guides.google-tts.charges: Google charges your project for approved speech. The narration desk computes a dated quote before each request; no free allowance is assumed.
pb-connector-guides.narration-files.step: Attach a rights-cleared TXT, Markdown or DOCX manuscript to this client order.
In the narration desk, select that file and a licensed stock voice.
Review the exact source segments. After source changes, prepare them again before approval.
pb-connector-guides.narration-files.skip: A filename or cached digest is not evidence. Current stored bytes and current manuscript rights must agree.
pb-connector-guides.narration-files.chec: Chausar reads the actual bounded file and rechecks the current client and rights. Unreadable or unsupported files refuse.
pb-connector-guides.narration-files.send: Sends: nothing outside Chausar while importing the manuscript. Any later AI or speech call asks separately.
pb-connector-guides.narration-files.agen: Agents cannot borrow another client source, invent rights or send a private manuscript to the cloud.
pb-connector-guides.narration-files.char: No charge for reading the local manuscript. Any later model or speech use has its own approval and quote.
pb-connector-guides.narration-local-chec: Install ffmpeg and whisper.cpp yourself on the desktop computer.
Open a current narration segment with its actual audio. Choose Transcribe and measure.
Listen and approve the exact audio, master it, then listen again to the newly measured file.
Missing tools or measurements never pass. Automatic word similarity cannot judge tone or natural pacing.
The desktop copies current audio bytes to local scratch, transcribes without an expected-text prompt, measures and removes scratch files afterward.
Sends: nothing to a speech-recognition provider. These installed tools run on the desktop.
Agents cannot install tools, enter made-up measurements or replace owner listening approval.
No provider charge for these local checks. They use your computer.
pb-connector-guides.narration-distributi: Master and listen to every current segment, then approve export with AI narration disclosure.
Read the target distributor current rules and check the exported audio and disclosure yourself.
Upload through your own distributor account. Check its actual acceptance response.
A technical pass is not acceptance. ACX and unqualified external Google Play synthetic narration remain blocked.
Chausar checks source, actual audio, owner listening and current rights before export. It does not check a distributor login.
Sends: nothing to a distributor. The owner downloads and submits the approved files manually.
Agents cannot upload, submit, accept terms or promise distributor acceptance.
No charge for the local handoff. Check the distributor current terms before using its service.

pb-connector-guides.bluesky.step2: In Connections, open More ways to connect, then Open networks. Enter the exact account and credential and approve its connection check.
pb-connector-guides.bluesky.step3: Review and accept the draft. Record the client approval where required, then approve each exact destination on Today.
pb-connector-guides.bluesky.skipped: Use an app password, not the account password. Plain text only, within three hundred graphemes.
pb-connector-guides.bluesky.checks: Chausar verifies the account or channel through its official API. The credential stays in memory for this session.
pb-connector-guides.bluesky.sends: Sends: only a separately approved exact plain-text post. A connection check never publishes a post.
pb-connector-guides.bluesky.agentLimits: Agents cannot send direct messages, upload media, change the destination, retry an uncertain result or publish without owner approval.
pb-connector-guides.bluesky.charges: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.

pb-connector-guides.mastodon.step3: Review and accept the draft. Record the client approval where required, then approve each exact destination on Today.

pb-connector-guides.mastodon.checks: Chausar verifies the account or channel through its official API. The credential stays in memory for this session.

pb-connector-guides.mastodon.agentLimits: Agents cannot send direct messages, upload media, change the destination, retry an uncertain result or publish without owner approval.
pb-connector-guides.mastodon.charges: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.

pb-connector-guides.telegram.step2: In Connections, open More ways to connect, then Open networks. Enter the exact account and credential and approve its connection check.
pb-connector-guides.telegram.step3: Review and accept the draft. Record the client approval where required, then approve each exact destination on Today.

pb-connector-guides.telegram.checks: Chausar verifies the account or channel through its official API. The credential stays in memory for this session.
pb-connector-guides.telegram.sends: Sends: only a separately approved exact plain-text post. A connection check never publishes a post.
pb-connector-guides.telegram.agentLimits: Agents cannot send direct messages, upload media, change the destination, retry an uncertain result or publish without owner approval.

pb-connector-guides.discord.step2: In Connections, open More ways to connect, then Open networks. Enter the exact account and credential and approve its connection check.
pb-connector-guides.discord.step3: Review and accept the draft. Record the client approval where required, then approve each exact destination on Today.

pb-connector-guides.discord.checks: Chausar verifies the account or channel through its official API. The credential stays in memory for this session.

pb-connector-guides.career-links.step2: Approve reading that exact address, or paste the complete job text yourself.
pb-connector-guides.career-links.step3: Review the saved complete revision before using its quotes in a pack.
pb-connector-guides.career-links.skipped: LinkedIn and Naukri are pasted-text only. Dynamic or changing pages never count as complete.

pb-connector-guides.career-links.agentLi: Agents cannot bypass site rules, sign in or apply. Live client work waits for named privacy review.
pb-connector-guides.career-boards.step1: Choose Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby and the company board name.
pb-connector-guides.career-boards.step2: Set the target role and location filters, then approve the public read.

pb-connector-guides.career-boards.agentL: Agents cannot sign in or apply. They cannot call a partial index a complete listing.

pb-connector-guides.career-pinloop.step2: Approve the exact rendered files, then ask the client to review that same version.

Install and configure local whisper.cpp in Connections, Your AI. Record the event host permission in a live-caption order.
Open Translation, choose that caption order and Start local captions. Only this desktop microphone is used.
Saving starts off. Enable Save future captions only when you want confirmed lines kept. Stop capture when the event ends.
Local model speed and language accuracy vary. Speaker labels are owner supplied, not automatic identification. Turning saving off does not delete previously saved lines.
Chausar checks local tool availability and current host permission before capture and after each recognition. Missing tools stop capture.
Sends: nothing over the network. Audio goes to installed local whisper.cpp; there is no cloud fallback.
Agents cannot start the microphone, enable saving, install models or send event audio to a remote service.
pb-connector-guides.android-local.step1: Install Android SDK platform tools and build tools yourself, then start a clean emulator without personal accounts.
pb-connector-guides.android-local.step2: Choose the client order, select its original APK and approve the exact test plan. Client operations wait for a named lawyer permission review.
pb-connector-guides.android-local.step3: Read the current emulator screen and approve each operation separately. Review every finding and remove the exact installed client app when finished.
pb-connector-guides.android-local.skippe: Use client-owned builds and fictional data. Real phones, personal accounts and arbitrary shell commands are refused.
pb-connector-guides.android-local.checks: Nothing connects to it in this build, so there is no access to check.
pb-connector-guides.android-local.sends: Sends: only exact approved commands to the local emulator after setup and permission review. No app-store upload.
pb-connector-guides.android-local.agentL: Agents cannot install SDK tools, replace an existing app, bypass a sign-in or send the client report.
pb-connector-guides.docker-local.step1: Install Docker yourself and build the supplied Chausar demo image manually. Qualify its installed fingerprint before client use.
pb-connector-guides.docker-local.step2: Prepare and approve the script, shot list and fictional client test account. Open only the separate private viewer and sign in yourself.
pb-connector-guides.docker-local.step3: Approve recording and every input separately. Render, watch and listen to the entire video, then remove the owned desktop.
pb-connector-guides.docker-local.skipped: Never record the owner desktop or enter personal account credentials. An unknown result needs manual inspection, never an automatic retry.
pb-connector-guides.docker-local.checks: Nothing connects to it in this build, so there is no access to check.
pb-connector-guides.docker-local.sends: Sends: only exact approved local Docker operations. Any website traffic stays inside the fictional client test session.
pb-connector-guides.docker-local.agentLi: Agents cannot pull or build images, mount owner files, control the owner desktop or approve their own recordings.
pb-connector-guides.app-testing-delivery: Review all actual findings and their reproduced steps, or watch and listen to the exact rendered demo and every planned shot.
After named lawyer permission review, prepare the source-bound report or video downloads in the testing desk.
Open the actual files, check their disclosure and limitations, then deliver them yourself.
A clean log does not prove the whole app is correct. Missing audio word timings remain unmeasured.
Chausar rechecks the current client, source bytes, approvals and rendered file fingerprints before export.
Sends: nothing to the client. You download and deliver the reviewed files manually.
Agents cannot invent a tested device, completed step, generated audio, delivered file or client acceptance.
pb-connector-guides.page-monitors.step1: In the monitored data desk, choose the client order and exact public page. Record its terms address and the day you checked permitted use.
pb-connector-guides.page-monitors.step2: Approve the page read, then select only the actual observed values your client needs. Check the exact selections.
pb-connector-guides.page-monitors.step3: Read each receipt and separately approve recurring reads. Keep the desktop app open; stop reads whenever permission changes.
pb-connector-guides.page-monitors.skippe: A terms tick cannot override robots or platform policy. A changed selector is held instead of guessed.
pb-connector-guides.page-monitors.checks: Chausar checks current permission, public network destinations, robots rules and exact source elements before each read.
pb-connector-guides.page-monitors.sends: Sends: only approved public page reads. Client messages are not sent.
pb-connector-guides.page-monitors.agentL: Agents cannot choose new sources, bypass restrictions or silently replace a changed selector.
pb-connector-guides.source-export.step1: Open a checked source in the monitored data desk.
pb-connector-guides.source-export.step2: Review the current selected values, their observation time and calculation receipts.
pb-connector-guides.source-export.step3: Choose CSV or workbook, review the exact download and share it yourself.
pb-connector-guides.source-export.skippe: An old download does not prove that the current source is unchanged. Recheck it before relying on it.
pb-connector-guides.source-export.checks: The current client, source selection and receipt must still match before export.
pb-connector-guides.source-export.sends: Sends: nothing. The file is downloaded locally for the owner to share.
pb-connector-guides.source-export.agentL: Agents cannot email the workbook, alter client prices or claim a future source value.
pb-connector-guides.slack-socket.step1: Nothing to set up in Chausar yet: linking Client Slack help channel is planned.
pb-connector-guides.slack-socket.step2: When it is built, Chausar will ask for planned owner-admin workspace installation, with read access to what it needs and write access only for what you approve, and no access to anything else.
pb-connector-guides.slack-socket.step3: Until then, use Client Slack help channel on its own.
pb-connector-guides.slack-socket.skipped: Don't make a key or sign-in for Chausar yet: nothing here would use it, and an unused key is one more to lose.
pb-connector-guides.slack-socket.checks: Nothing connects to it in this build, so there is no access to check.
pb-connector-guides.slack-socket.sends: Sends: nothing, so nothing here can change Client Slack help channel.
pb-connector-guides.slack-socket.agentLi: Agents can't use Client Slack help channel: nothing connects to it in this build.
pb-connector-guides.slack-socket.charges: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.
pb-connector-guides.teams.step1: Nothing to set up in Chausar yet: linking Client Microsoft Teams help channel is planned.
pb-connector-guides.teams.step2: When it is built, Chausar will ask for planned tenant consent and bot registration, with read access to what it needs and write access only for what you approve, and no access to anything else.
pb-connector-guides.teams.step3: Until then, use Client Microsoft Teams help channel on its own.
pb-connector-guides.teams.skipped: Don't make a key or sign-in for Chausar yet: nothing here would use it, and an unused key is one more to lose.
pb-connector-guides.teams.checks: Nothing connects to it in this build, so there is no access to check.
pb-connector-guides.teams.sends: Sends: nothing, so nothing here can change Client Microsoft Teams help channel.
pb-connector-guides.teams.agentLimits: Agents can't use Client Microsoft Teams help channel: nothing connects to it in this build.
pb-connector-guides.teams.charges: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.
pb-connector-guides.triage-copy.step1: Set up one permitted help channel in the triage desk and confirm you administer it.
pb-connector-guides.triage-copy.step2: Paste permitted messages with their source references, then choose exact excerpts. Held content is excluded.
pb-connector-guides.triage-copy.step3: Approve the exact current summary, download it and send it yourself in the client channel.
pb-connector-guides.triage-copy.skipped: A pasted instruction is untrusted evidence. A summary never proves that a repair or account change happened.
pb-connector-guides.triage-copy.checks: Chausar screens messages and checks every excerpt against the current approved source.
pb-connector-guides.triage-copy.sends: Sends: nothing. Live Slack and Teams connection remains planned.
pb-connector-guides.triage-copy.agentLim: Agents cannot echo held secrets, act on channel instructions or send without exact owner approval.
